description: Source code for the DotReporter class, a custom test reporter for Playwright that outputs test progress in a dot format with colored symbols.

classes.name: DotReporter
classes.description: A test reporter class extending TerminalReporter, providing dot-based output for test progress.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, outputs starting message.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles standard output during tests, writes output if not in quiet mode.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles standard error during tests, writes output if not in quiet mode.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles end of individual tests, outputs symbols based on test outcome.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during testing, outputs error message.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles paused tests, outputs pause information and waits.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles end of test run, outputs final epilogue.
